create_AdamInverseSqrtWithWarmup: create an AdamInverseSqrtWithWarmup optimizer with warmup and inverse square root decay for neural network training
configure_warmup_updates: configure the warmup_updates parameter to set the number of updates for linear learning rate warmup
get_lr_for_step: get the learning rate for a given update step number using warmup or inverse square root decay
step_optimizer: step the optimizer to perform an update and automatically adjust the learning rate
set_warmup_init_lr: set the warmup_init_lr parameter to define the initial learning rate at the start of training
